name: What's the real cost of AEO software, and is it worth the investment?

mainEntity.name: What's the real cost of AEO software, and is it worth the investment?

acceptedAnswer.text: AEO software costs vary widely: basic monitoring tools range from $50–$200/month, while enterprise platforms with competitive AI market share analysis cost $500–$2,000+/month. Some vendors bundle AEO tracking with traditional SEO analytics, while others offer standalone AI visibility dashboards focused on citation tracking.
acceptedAnswer.description: Basic AEO tools cost $50–$200/month; enterprise platforms range $500–$2,000+/month. Worth it if you need AI citation tracking, share-of-answers metrics, and competitive AI market analysis.
